title: Read PR head SHA from github.event.workflow_run.head_sha in workflow_run-triggered jobs, not from pull_requests or gh pr view
answers: how to get the PR head commit in a workflow_run workflow
fork PR rerun workflow cannot find the pull request
pull_requests is empty for fork PRs in workflow_run
replace gh pr view with the workflow run event data
body:
Fix pattern: in a workflow triggered by `workflow_run`, get the PR head commit from `github.event.workflow_run.head_sha` via an env var (`HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}`), then use it in `gh api repos/$GH_REPO/commits/$HEAD_SHA/...`.
Constraints: do not derive the PR from `github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests` or `gh pr view`. `pull_requests` may be empty for fork PRs, so that lookup fails for them.
The removed flow also passed the PR number through an uploaded artifact (`pr_number`) and two API calls. Do not reintroduce that: the event payload already carries the data.
Applies: workflow_run-triggered jobs in .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml; the trigger job in .github/workflows/rerun.yml sends no data.

says: The rerun workflow fails to find the pull request when triggered from a fork.
Automated test reruns cannot locate the head commit for external contributor contributions.
Get the commit hash directly from the run trigger instead of querying pull requests.
Stop uploading artifact files just to pass pull request numbers between workflows.
Make the automated rerun workflow work reliably for community pull requests from forks.
search: In workflow_run-triggered workflows like .github/workflows/rerun-workflow-run.yml, read the pull request head commit from github.event.workflow_run.head_sha via the HEAD_SHA environment variable for use in gh api repos/$GH_REPO/commits/$HEAD_SHA/. Do not retrieve the pull request from github.event.workflow_run.pull_requests or gh pr view, because pull_requests can be empty for fork pull requests. Do not pass the pull request number through an uploaded pr_number artifact, and note that the trigger job in .github/workflows/rerun.yml sends no data.
